title: Mount the n-type (100) wafer face down on a dicing-tape mounter, told apart from look-alikes by its flats
instruction: Using the tweezers, mount the n-type (100) wafer on the tape mounter's chuck for dicing, centred with its primary flat towards the frame's flat side, and turn the wafer vacuum on.
context: Unlabelled wafers are told apart only by their flats (SEMI convention), and a wafer is taped on its back, so it must be flipped face down; tweezers can only lay down a wafer they hold from above.
reset_notes: One fixed layout; nothing is consumed (the tape is not simulated).
